bioAdditions:
Nancy Anne Stahl Meier, wife of William F. Meier Jr. (H0009, d. 29 Feb 2004), is recorded on FamilySearch as dying on 13 May 2009 in Florida, residence Clermont, aged about 79 (S1). Three independent index entries are attached: a GenealogyBank obituary under 'Nancy Stahl Meier', a Find a Grave index entry under 'Nancy Anne Stahl Meier', and an obituary-records entry under 'Nancy Stahl' (S1). The site's own bio for H0009 already reports this death, yet her record H0384 is still flagged presumed living. She should be marked deceased.

Whether Stahl is her maiden name or the name of a first husband is unclear. The FS tree also links her to a 'Jack Stahl' (GV6C-Z4T) as a spouse. His only source is a 2014-2023 obituary entry for 'John Stahl' whose ark ID sits next to hers (XMK2-9SZP vs XMK2-9SZ5). That suggests both are named in the same later obituary, possibly as parents, so Jack may be her father rather than a husband. This is unresolved.
